title: Celestial Purple Sorceress
description: A female character with white hair in an ornate updo stands in a dynamic combat pose against a solid gray background. She wears a white and purple traditional-style outfit with armor elements and wields two large magical crescent weapons glowing with purple starlight and constellation patterns.
prompt: A fierce young woman with pale white hair in an elaborate traditional updo and glowing purple celestial crown, wearing a white and purple East Asian inspired battle outfit with corset and flowing fabric, stands in a powerful stance. She holds two massive magical crescent blades, one small and one very large, both crackling with intense purple starlight, constellations, and magical energy. Solid gray background, clean digital illustration style, vibrant purple and white color scheme.
